method: elementFromPoint probes in 0.5px steps around every visible control and at points inside it. The record holds the box the browser actually delivers, without adding a CSS declared size, so a clipped or covered control cannot pass. A control still clipped after scrolling stays in the rows as a covered row with a zero hit area. Overlap is compared in document coordinates after any scroll. Measured in the gallery at 1280 and 1920. Sizes are floored to whole CSS pixels so a half pixel boundary cannot move the record.
